items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I was telling you, Professor Charlie Lee, he was staying two doors from him.

ctx.x: I guess you were living there Willie Parker or something. I was. Has he been there where he is now for years?

Yeah, well he was staying right around the corner. Two doors from this old professor. I was telling you, Professor Charlie Lee, he was staying two doors from him. And he stood there, I'd say about 35 years in that one house. And after he moved from there, he moved where he's staying at now. It's in Fuller Street. That's the only two places I've ever learned this day.
And he was staying at the same time. So it was partly a matter of just being lucky to live near somebody who was a nice guy and played music and helped him.
